newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-TOSHACK IN TROUBLE AS DEPORTIVO FALL AT EXTREMADURA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TOSHACK IN TROUBLE AS DEPORTIVO FALL AT EXTREMADURA.

text.p: Struggling Extremadura rounded off a disastrous week for Deportivo Coruna's John Toshack by snatching a scrappy 1-0 victory in Saturday's Spanish league fixture.

Deportivo's first away defeat of the the season left Toshack's side four points adrift of second-placed Barcelona, who face Rayo Vallecano on Sunday, and is bound to increase pressure on the beleaguered coach.
Earlier in the week Deportivo began disciplinary proceedings against the Welshman for insulting the crowd in last weekend's game against Athletic Bilbao.

But the threat of action by the International Football Federation (FIFA) against Deportivo has faded since club president Augusto Lendoiro withdrew a civil law suit to prevent the closure of the Riazor stadium because of a coin-throwing incident.
Elsewhere, Atletico Madrid have appealed to Spanish authorities to postpone Sunday's game at Tenerife because of a bout of gastro-enteritis which has laid low 10 members of the champions' squad.
